articles.highlight: 巴西政府表示，所有国家现在就可以开始摆脱对化石燃料的依赖，无需等待新技术或经济变革。
articles.summary: 巴西在COP30前发布全球首份化石燃料淘汰路线图，提出摆脱煤炭、石油和天然气的步骤，并希望把气候议程从谈判转向落实。报道强调，巴西认为各国无需等待新技术或经济条件变化即可行动，同时可兼顾经济增长和减贫。对关注国际气候治理的人来说，这提供了观察全球能源转型执行路径的一个信号。

articles.title: Love in the Time of Dinosaurs
articles.highlight: 他意识到这些并非先前以为的大象遗骸，而是一种在化石记录和现存世界中都找不到对应物的巨大食肉爬行动物。
articles.summary: 1824年，威廉·巴克兰研究牛津附近采石场出土的大型化石骨骼时，发现下颌骨碎片与“大象遗骸”的旧判断不符。他认定这是一种在化石记录和现存世界中都没有对应物的巨大食肉爬行动物，将其命名为斑龙（Megalosaurus），即第一种被命名的恐龙，并着手撰写完整描述。这个小异常推翻旧假设并开启新类别的过程，值得非技术读者体会。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：重大认知突破常始于一个“不对劲”的细节；先命名并系统描述异常，能把模糊疑问变成可研究的新类别。
articles.sourceExcerpt: In 1824, studying a set of large fossil bones discovered in a quarry near Oxford two centuries earlier, the English theologian, geologist, and paleontologist William Buckland kept looking at the fragment of the lower jaw. Something didn’t add up. As he examined it more closely, he realized these were not the remains of an elephant, as previously thought, but of an enormous carnivorous reptile with no analogue in the fossil record or in the living world.

zh.title: 恐龙时代的爱：第一只被命名的恐龙
zh.highlight: 他意识到这些并非先前以为的大象遗骸，而是一种在化石记录和现存世界中都找不到对应物的巨大食肉爬行动物。
zh.summary: 1824年，威廉·巴克兰研究牛津附近采石场出土的大型化石骨骼时，发现下颌骨碎片与“大象遗骸”的旧判断不符。他认定这是一种在化石记录和现存世界中都没有对应物的巨大食肉爬行动物，将其命名为斑龙（Megalosaurus），即第一种被命名的恐龙，并着手撰写完整描述。这个小异常推翻旧假设并开启新类别的过程，值得非技术读者体会。
zh.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：重大认知突破常始于一个“不对劲”的细节；先命名并系统描述异常，能把模糊疑问变成可研究的新类别。

en.highlight: Examining the jaw more closely, he realized it was not an elephant’s remains but those of an enormous carnivorous reptile with no analogue in the fossil record or living world.
en.summary: In 1824, William Buckland studied large fossil bones from an Oxford quarry and noticed that the lower jaw did not fit the prevailing elephant explanation. He identified the remains as a giant carnivorous reptile unlike anything in the fossil record or the living world, named it Megalosaurus, and began a full account. It is worth reading as a case of a small anatomical anomaly overturning an old assumption and creating a new category.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: breakthroughs often begin with a detail that does not add up; naming and systematically describing the anomaly can turn it into a researchable new category.
en.title: Love in the Time of Dinosaurs: The First Named Dinosaur

articles.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Expert analysis
articles.summary: 论文把 LLM 直接分析、修改浮点权重称为 Weight-Space Programming，并称 GPT-6 Astra 仅看权重就能识别网络任务，甚至无需梯度、只改动少量权重来提升数学表现。Simon Willison 用笔记本上的 Qwen 3.8 27B 复现“从权重猜游戏”示例，它成功识别 Pac-Man、Pong 和 Breakout，但在更冷门的 Freeway 上失败。围绕该论文的批评指出，应区分无工具理解权重与借助代码更新模型，后者更接近人类研究流程；因此它值得读，但不足以宣告源码时代结束。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键收获是：模型直接读权重的能力确实有趣，但“看懂”与“用代码改好”是两类能力，不能把演示效果直接外推为模型自治改写权重的新时代。
articles.highlight: 仅凭原始权重，GPT-6 Astra 就能判断一个神经网络当初被训练来做什么。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Yesterday's hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab. The paper (OK, the authors classify is as a "blog post", but it's paper-shaped) found that frontier models, in particular GPT-6 Astra, can both interpret and modify the raw weights of a machine learning model - literally a text description of the model containing a bunch of floating point numbers. I've been playing with one of the examples from the paper and I'm delighted to share that Qwen 3.8 27B running on my laptop can do this as well!

en.highlight: Just by looking at the raw weights, GPT-6 Astra can tell what a network was trained to do.
en.summary: The paper coins “Weight-Space Programming” for LLMs that analyze and edit raw floating-point weights, claiming GPT-6 Astra can infer a network’s task from weights alone and improve Qwen3.5-0.8B’s math performance by editing a tiny fraction of weights without gradients. Simon Willison reproduces the game-identification demo with Qwen 3.8 27B on his laptop: it identifies Pac-Man, Pong, and Breakout but fails on the more obscure Freeway. Critics argue the work conflates no-tool weight interpretation with code-assisted model improvement, so it is worth reading as a striking demo rather than proof that source code is obsolete.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is to separate weight interpretation from code-assisted weight editing; the demo is striking, but it does not justify declaring the end of source code or a new era of self-editing models.
